Comfy staff move assets faster. Allegedly.

About output. But it looks a lot like caring.
{employee_id}: {node} rank {rank}. Please enjoy responsibly.

{employee_id}: {creature} grew into {new}.
Bigger asset, bigger value. Your pay: unchanged.

Upgrades for staff are not in this quarter's plan.
{new}. Bigger, stronger, pricier. Good asset, {employee_id}.

{employee_id}: The Benchmark, closed. You've been measured.

Faster staff, more assets per hour. Lace up.

One Trail down. The asset map wants many more.

{employee_id}...

Good. Rivals are bad for business.

Our assets beat his assets. That's the headline.

Repairs come out of somewhere. Not our budget.
